verdict.delta_sentence: Compared with the nearer gc-decomp-harness reference, this board offers clearer phase-by-phase grouping and stronger vertical process rhythm, but its dense canary region has more ambiguous converging routes and less breathing room.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The three delivery phases, evidence sidebar, and bottom invariants band use the wide frame deliberately, although the broad gaps around the sidebar and above the invariants slightly loosen the composition.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most vertical stages and pill labels have clear air, but the central canary rollback, telemetry, and promotion routes crowd one another and become harder to scan at reduced size.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Blue, teal, purple, gray, and amber tinted regions provide explicit and effective grouping for build, staging, canary production, evidence, and invariants.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Color is consistently semantic across normal flow, success, warning, rollback, and phase families; the restrained fills remain distinguishable without becoming decorative noise.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair junction glyphs or orphaned badges are visible, but the central red/orange/green route convergence near rollback and promotion exposes some routing machinery and makes attachment points less immediate.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The build and staging columns maintain strong vertical registers, while the intentionally denser canary section is visually balanced by the evidence column; minor irregularity appears in the central decision cluster.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Most edges are orthogonal, color-coded, and clean, but the long rollback run across the canary region and several close central bends create ambiguous convergence and one conspicuous detour.

verdict.rank_order_sanity_note: The visual ordering and assigned scores agree: gc-decomp-harness and the board under grade are effectively tied at 7.5, both ranking above intent-classification-2 at 7.0 for fuller grouping and more deliberate density.
